name: Kirinskoye BTK-Sakhalin Compressor Station Gas Pipeline (Sakhalin-3)

values.PipelineName: Kirinskoye BTK-Sakhalin Compressor Station Gas Pipeline
values.EndLocation: Sakhalin Compressor Station (head CS of Sakhalin-Khabarovsk-Vladivostok)

researcher_notes: Not in GEM roster (P0758 starts at Sakhalin CS, so this feed is upstream of it). neftegaz.ru 2026-09 (url_verifier OK, '139'): commercial gas from Kirinskoye BTK goes via a 139 km pipeline to head CS Sakhalin of SKhV; field in production since 2014 (first gas Oct 2013), operator Gazprom dobycha shelf Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk. Status operating inferred from present tense + field operating; single source, medium. CAVEAT: same article says BTK is being expanded for Yuzhno-Kirinskoye (full launch 2028) with NEW pipelines incl. a separate gas pipeline to GKS Sakhalin under construction (length not given); unclear whether that duplicates/replaces the 139 km line - Baird to check. Diameter/capacity/dates not sourced (field design 5.5 bcm/y is field not pipe). Owner per Gazprom operator ref (g). Route not researched.
